observations: All 5 retained sdk1 trials: host producer pacing within guards (max lateness 16-24 ms); source RPC completed, host input OFF, gate ALLOW.
Every failing trial had guest HAL virtual-sound I/O errors inside the capture window; neither passing trial had any (A03/1: 22 playback EIO; V03/1: 13 capture EIO; V03/2: 48 capture EIO).
HAL late-frame silence insertions: V03/1 1456 ms, V03/2 5088 ms; passes 96-112 ms (startup only).
Captured/fixture energy ratio is exactly 4.000 (lossless, time-stretched) for V03/1 and both passes, 3.913 (loss) for A03/1 and 0 for V03/2.
V03/2 capture I/O errors began about 1.8 s before its injection RPC started (guest clock offset +0.44 s), so they are not producer-caused.
Direct decoder on the clean pinned ACK fixture is exact and deterministic across offsets 0/250/500/1000 ms, floors 0/8 and three repeats (retained phase-08-speech-decoder-* evidence).
App capture is faithful to what the HAL delivers (exact energy); decoder, gate and confirmation layers are not implicated by these failures.

hypotheses.text: Producer pacing/overwrite in MODE_REAL_TIME corrupts speech
hypotheses.status: NOT_SUPPORTED: failures occur with on-time pacing and before injection
REFUTED_FOR_RETAINED_FAILURES: clean fixture deterministic; failing captures were not intact in time

hypotheses.text: Emulator virtual sound device stalls/I-O errors (host audio backend clocks virtio-snd)
hypotheses.status: SUPPORTED_BY_CORRELATION; backend cause UNPROVEN; tested below

change.description: Launch the isolated engine with '-audio none' (null host audio backend; distinct from -no-audio) so virtio-snd timing does not depend on Windows DirectSound devices.

protocol: Boot nullaudio1: preserved-data cold boot with -audio none; verify running engine command line, identity, host input OFF, rows/preferences/settings/APKs unchanged.
Probe: A03 once via the unchanged reviewed parent (excluded from the frozen comparison, retained).
Cohort 1 (only if probe delivered injected PCM): fixed order A03/1, V03/1, V03/2, V04/1, V04/2 with fresh registered fixtures.
Boot nullaudio2 then Cohort 2 with the same order (only if Cohort 1 does not repeat the same failure signature).

Each trial: unchanged reviewed parent assertions (exact pinned reference, copy/review/Confirm, paired SQL, zero registrations), restoration checks, plus a read-only HAL record that never changes status.
stopRules: Probe NO_AUDIO with zero captured energy and no device I/O error: injection unsupported under null backend -> stop, record, reboot defaultaudio1.
Probe or Cohort 1 shows a virtual-sound device I/O error: H3 backend hypothesis refuted -> do not run Cohort 2; record and restore.
Cohort 1 repeats a lexical/no-signal failure with nothing changed -> Cohort 2 NOT RUN.
Any guest stall/pre-recording UI failure: stop issuing audio trials; bounded recovery per handoff section 4.
limits: Emulator transport experiment only. No phone accuracy, audibility or performance claim; no new model, prompt, threshold or grammar change.
